review.method: Read-only source and finalized JSON verification; no crossing detection, matching retuning, force integral, FK or dynamics.

corrected_verdict: P0_M10 is a counterexample to unique pylon-length necessity for producing loaded contact in this bench with active reserves. It does not establish complete phase agreement, correct mounting, physiological gait or clinical adequacy, and is not better on all diagnostics.

P0_M10_force_onset.chronological_comparison_note: Ordered within-cycle descriptive offsets, not newly accepted matcher pairs. Original120msHSmatcher remains unchanged.
P0_M10_force_onset.binary_and_retained_actor_primary_events: No retained ordinary HS/TO recorded on the nominal primary comparison; this differs from physical force crossings.

current_P4_A1.scope: Binary/actor onset is a separate geometryFSM channel. ClosingHS late matching support is incomplete even when an observed crossing was matched; raw matcher counts are retained.

limits: Three fully observable unmatched short-case HS references are diagnostic timing disagreements against healthy measured nominal events; closingHS is censored, not a fourth physiological miss.
Inherited120/180ms onset tolerances are diagnostic pairing criteria, not new clinical/hardware acceptance gates.
Reserve work, tracking, load magnitude and event timing express different tradeoffs; no selected case is promoted to uniformly optimal or fully validated.
Raw healthy contact, virtual force law and binary geometry detector differ; their disagreements alone do not uniquely establish preparation error.
